text:
alex: Heads up — customer reported a double bill on a streaming request after a mid-request model downgrade + reconnect. Router logs show a truncated toolcall followed by a fallback path that looks like it captured the suffix twice. Anyone seen this pattern?

rachel: Seen something similar in canary yesterday, small spike in provisional tokens. console trace for session 0x9f3 looked odd.

jamal: Yup, alert came across my desk. Repro steps were: start stream -> induce model swap -> client reconnect -> stream resumes on fallback route -> toolcall truncated then retried. Billing pipeline shows provisional then confirmed for both chunks.

li: Quick suspicion: prefetch + resume handoff kept a tombstone missing, so suffix got stitched as a new prefix on fallback. That would result in two separate token attributions.

alex: Can you paste the router log snippet?

rachel: Here — log cut: ```
2026-02-11T14:02:21Z router[proxy-11] INFO session=0x9f3 route=primary model=gpt-open-8k prefix_len=312
2026-02-11T14:02:23Z router[proxy-11] WARN session=0x9f3 fallback=us-west-2b route=secondary reason=model_swap
2026-02-11T14:02:24Z runtime[worker-3] INFO toolcall=id=tc_42 truncated=true tokens=124
2026-02-11T14:02:25Z router[proxy-11] INFO session=0x9f3 resume=secondary stitch=claimed suffix_len=90
```

jamal: That stitch=claimed line looks suspect. If the ledger didn't mark the original prefix tombstoned when the primary dropped, fallback stitched and we ended up with prefix+suffix counted twice.

alex: What's the short-term mitigation? Disable stitch on fallback for safe mode? Add dedupe at billing join?

li: Short-term: disable automatic resume-stitching for the next 1% of traffic (safe mode) and flag sessions that attempted stitch for manual review. Longer-term: propagate an idempotency/session token down to billing so toolcall charges dedupe on id.

rachel: Console UX request: surface provisional vs confirmed per-session more clearly and show the routing path (primary->fallback) so support can triage quickly. Right now it's buried in traces.

jamal: Also propose emitting a router event field route_handoff_reason and route_tags (e.g., "model_swap", "prefetch_handoff") so billing / telemetry can apply heuristics.

alex: Good. Can someone open a short-run playbook? Playbook items: 1) enable safe-mode no-stitch for 1% by feature-flag, 2) add router event field to telemetry, 3) console tweak to show provisional/confirmed and route path, 4) small billing-side dedupe based on toolcall id for suspected sessions.

li: I'll open a PR for the telemetry field and a follow-up ticket for billing propagation.

rachel: I'll draft the console mock and a short support-facing blurb explaining provisional vs confirmed tokens and how to spot stitch events.

jamal: I'll own the feature-flag rollout (canary -> 1% -> 10%) and add an observability dashboard that surfaces stitch attempts + double-confirm rates.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-1327 "Investigate double-attribution on resumed streaming toolcalls" (linked: https://redwoodproj/PLAT-1327).

alex: Thanks. Quick follow-up: prioritize the dedupe by toolcall id in billing as highest. If we can prevent confirmed double credits that's the fastest fix. :thumbsup:

li: Agreed — will mark billing propagation as P0 on the PR.

rachel: +1. I'll share the console mock in #eng-platform-design later today.

jamal: Will add dashboard panels and a probe alert to catch regressions.

alex: Great — ping here when PRs/tickets exist so we can close the loop.

rachel: pinged. Thanks everyone. :coffee:
